primitives.meaning: a previously paid relationship has been inactive and unpaid past its lapse threshold
entryFilters: the relationship was paid - at least one completed paid term or purchase on it
it ended or went dormant under the company's lapse rule, and the cancellation's own save window and cooldown have passed
no active obligation, subscription, open complaint, payment recovery or process exists on the relationship
the recorded cancellation reason is not one policy lists as excluding outreach, and the refund and dispute history does not exclude it
purpose-level permission for commercial communication is recorded and was not withdrawn at cancellation, and hard gates (GLB-31) allow it

primitives.asks: Is this relationship one we may write to about coming back?

branches.label: Eligible
branches.observes: relationship record, cancellation reason, refund and dispute history, permission record
branches.test: paid before, lapsed past the cancellation's own window, nothing open on it, a reason and history that do not exclude outreach, permission recorded and not withdrawn

branches.label: Excluded
branches.observes: cancellation reason, refund and dispute history, open items, permission record
branches.test: the reason, the history, something open, or absent permission rules it out - the reason is recorded

primitives.does: Open the win-back instance against the relationship and this lapse, recording the cancellation reason it will speak to and the date the cooldown will be counted from

primitives.asks: What can the invitation honestly say?

branches.label: Something changed that speaks to why they left
branches.test: a recorded change since the lapse addresses the recorded reason - a fixed problem, a changed plan, a restored feature

branches.label: Nothing specific
branches.test: no recorded change speaks to the reason, or no reason was recorded - the invitation is plain

branches.label: Sendable
branches.test: the send path passes: permission for commercial communication, a deliverable destination, the promotional pressure cap, no higher-precedence contest on the account, and no win-back cooldown in force

branches.label: Suppressed
branches.test: a gate stops it; the gate is recorded as the reason

primitives.does: Record why nothing was sent - an excluding reason, history, something open, no permission, or a gate on the send path - so no-action is a measured outcome

competition.precedence: lowest in the group - any live retention, complaint, risk or payment journey on the account means the relationship is not lapsed and this journey does not run

orderedRoles.eligibleWhen: the invitation should say what changed and carry the route back, and survive until the person reads it - the default for someone who is not in the product
a valid push token still exists on a device the person kept the app on, and the route back is a single step

primitives.purpose: A plain invitation to come back: what actually changed since they left where something did, the route back, and nothing invented.
primitives.brief: Invite them back plainly: what actually changed since they left where something did, and the route back. Nothing invented, no terms held that are not held, no discount policy does not enable

mustNotClaim: a change that did not happen
that their previous terms are held
a discount policy does not enable

primitives.label: CANONICAL_RULE

primitives.key: person_id + relationship_id + lapse date + touch id

cancelOn.meaning: an authoritative purchase for the person, on any subject

primitives.reads: the relationship re-read: still lapsed, nothing opened on it, permission still recorded

primitives.asks: Is a follow-up enabled, and is there something honest to add?

branches.label: Enabled with something to add
branches.test: the company has enabled the follow-up (winback.follow_up_enabled) and either an incentive policy enables an offer for the last touch or a further change is recorded

branches.label: Not enabled, or nothing to add
branches.test: the follow-up is disabled, or there is nothing honest to say beyond the invitation already sent

branches.label: Sendable
branches.test: the send path passes and the touch budget is not spent

branches.label: Suppressed
branches.test: a gate stops it; the gate is recorded

competition.precedence: lowest in the group - any live retention, complaint, risk or payment journey on the account means the relationship is not lapsed and this journey does not run

orderedRoles.eligibleWhen: the invitation should say what changed and carry the route back, and survive until the person reads it - the default for someone who is not in the product
a valid push token still exists on a device the person kept the app on, and the route back is a single step

primitives.purpose: One follow-up, only where the company enables it and there is something honest to add - an incentive policy enables, or a further change - with the same route back.
primitives.brief: Say once what is being added - the enabled incentive, or the further change - with the same route back, and record the incentive's issuance per person where one is issued

that their previous terms are held

primitives.reads: the relationship re-read from the system of record

primitives.state: won back; the relationship is repaid
primitives.reEntry: a later lapse is a new instance, subject to the cooldown counted from this lapse

primitives.state: no invitation sent; the excluding reason or gate is recorded
primitives.reEntry: an excluding reason or history is re-evaluated only when it changes; a gate on the send path is re-evaluated at the next lapse

primitives.state: invited, not returned; left alone for the cooldown
primitives.reEntry: no further win-back instance until the cooldown has passed
